title: openCost JSON Schema
description: Validates openCost records in JSON. Automatically transformed from the pydantic models based on the original openCost XSD Schema.

AmountInvoice.description: Contains the total price as stated on the invoice (§7.2.4, §7.1.3.4).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the total amount as stated on the invoice.
currency.title: Currency

amount.description: Total amount as stated on the invoice. Net monetary value.
amount.title: Amount

AmountInvoice.title: AmountInvoice

BibliographicInformation.description:
Block of bibliographic metadata describing the publication (§2.2).

This serves as a backup and only has to be given if no `doi` can be
provided. Contains a subset of Dublin Core elements.

Title.description: Title of the publication. Dublin Core term (http://purl.org/dc/terms/title).
Title.title: Title

Publisher.description: Publisher of the journal. Dublin Core term (http://purl.org/dc/terms/publisher).
Publisher.title: Publisher

isPartOf.description: Name of the journal. Dublin Core term (http://purl.org/dc/terms/isPartOf).
isPartOf.title: Ispartof

BibliographicInformation.title: BibliographicInformation

CoarPublicationType.description:
Publication type as the reporting institution categorizes it (§5).

Members are the COAR controlled vocabulary (v3.2) English labels plus the
corresponding COAR PURLs in both `https` (``*_purl``) and `http`
(``*_purl_http``) spellings - matching the openCost schema enumeration
exactly. PURLs are recommended as language-independent persistent
identifiers; a document parsed with an `http` PURL re-serializes with
`http` unchanged.
CoarPublicationType.title: CoarPublicationType

ContractAmountPaidType.description:
An amount paid by the institution (§7.1.3.5.1).

Usually corresponding to an item on the invoice.

amount.description: Amount of the `amount_paid`. Net monetary value. Negative or zero values are valid to denote reimbursements.
amount.title: Amount

cost_type.description: Describes the object/purpose of the payment. If the VAT cannot be subdivided specifically for the individual cost types, but only for the total amount of the invoice, a separate entry with the `cost_type` `vat` is possible here instead of the `vat` field (7.1.3.5.1.4).

vat.description: Vat of the `amount_paid`. State in the same currency as `amount`. Must be specified and assigned according to the individual cost type; if a differentiated specification is not possible, use a separate entry with `cost_type` `vat` (7.1.3.5.1.3).
vat.title: Vat

ContractAmountPaidType.title: ContractAmountPaidType

ContractAmountsPaid.description:
Contains all itemized amounts paid corresponding to one invoice of a
contract (§7.1.3.5).
ContractAmountsPaid.title: ContractAmountsPaid

ContractCostDataType.description:
Aggregates payments related to a contract (§7, contract).

The `invoice` elements can be combined into one or more common
`invoice_group` elements referring to a shared `invoices_period` of the
contract concerned.

invoice_group.description: The billing periods of the contract.
invoice_group.title: Invoice Group

ContractCostDataType.title: ContractCostDataType

ContractCostType.description:
Contract cost type (§7.1.3.5.1.3): the object/purpose of the payment.

Definitions from the openCost cost-types glossary:

- `publish`: charges for Open Access publishing within the framework of
  (e.g. Publish & Read) contracts; flat rate to cover all publication
  services for publishing in publication organs covered by the contract.
- `read`: charges for the read access of a Closed Access portfolio within
  the framework of (e.g. Publish & Read or subscription) contracts.
- `publish and read`: charges for publishing under 'Publish & Read' or
  'Read & Publish' contracts where the publish and read portions are not
  itemized separately on an invoice.
- `service fee`: additional charges to cover service and operating costs.
- `vat`: value added tax.
ContractCostType.title: ContractCostType

ContractInvoiceGroupType.description:
Contains all invoices that belong to a billing period within a contract
(§7.1).

Such a contract phase is limited by a time period (`invoices_period`) to
which a respective invoice can be assigned.

group_id.description: An id to uniquely name and identify the `invoice_group`. Necessary to link not only from an individual publication to the global contract but also to a specific invoice and contract period: relates cost data for an `opencost:publication` to this contract via the `opencost:part_of_contract` element. Generating a `uuid` or using another type of unique identifier is recommended.
group_id.title: Group Id

invoices_period.description: Identifies the time frame the invoices in this group refer to.

invoice.description: The invoices belonging to this billing period.
invoice.title: Invoice

ContractInvoiceGroupType.title: ContractInvoiceGroupType

ContractInvoicePeriodType.description: Identifies the time frame an invoice refers to (§7.1.2).

from.description: Start date of the time frame the invoice refers to. Can be different to an institution's contract accession (`participation // from`) if multiple invoices have been issued over the total contract duration.
from.title: From

to.description: End date of the time frame the invoice refers to. Can be different to an institution's contract termination (`participation // to`) if multiple invoices have been issued over the total contract duration.
to.title: To

ContractInvoicePeriodType.title: ContractInvoicePeriodType

ContractInvoiceType.description:
Encapsulates payment information for a contract, meant to correspond to
a real-world invoice (§7.1.3).

amount_invoice.description: The total price as stated on the invoice for the contract.

invoice_number.description: Optional invoice number. As mentioned on the invoice.
invoice_number.title: Invoice Number

creditor.description: Payment receiver as mentioned on the invoice. Might not be the actual publisher, but also e.g. a service provider.
creditor.title: Creditor

amounts_paid.description: All itemized amounts paid corresponding to this invoice.

ContractInvoiceType.title: ContractInvoiceType

ContractPrimaryIdentifier.description:
Persistent, global identifier for the contract (§5).

Currently an `ESAC` ID
(https://esac-initiative.org/about/transformative-agreements/agreement-registry/)
or an `opencostid` (a self-issued id for the contract).
ContractPrimaryIdentifier.title: ContractPrimaryIdentifier

ContractPrimaryIdentifierType.description:
Contract primary identifier scheme (§5.1).

`ESAC` or `opencostid` is accepted.
ContractPrimaryIdentifierType.title: ContractPrimaryIdentifierType

ContractSecondaryIdentifiersType.description: Contains additional, optional identifiers for the contract (§6).
ContractSecondaryIdentifiersType.title: ContractSecondaryIdentifiersType

ContractType.description:
Top-level element, corresponds to a contract for which costs are to be
recorded (§1).

Examples of such contracts are transformative agreements and memberships.

contract_name.description: A human-readable label for the contract.
contract_name.title: Contract Name

institution.description: Contains information to identify the institution taking part in the contract.

participation.description: The dates the institution joined and left the contract.

primary_identifier.description: Persistent, global identifier for the contract; currently `ESAC` or `opencostid` is accepted.

secondary_identifiers.description: Additional, optional identifiers for the contract.

cost_data.description: Aggregates payments related to this contract.

ContractType.title: ContractType

Dates.description:
Contains different payment-related dates (§7.2.3).

At least one of `invoice` or `paid` must be given.

invoice.description: Invoice date. Either this element or the date `paid` is required.
invoice.title: Invoice

paid.description: Date of payment. Either this element or the invoice date is required.
paid.title: Paid

Dates.title: Dates

InstitutionId.description: Contains persistent identifiers for an institution (§4.1, §3.1).

value.description: Institution identifier value, e.g. a ROR id.
value.title: Value

InstitutionId.title: InstitutionId

InstitutionIdType.description: Identifier scheme an institution can be referenced by.
InstitutionIdType.title: InstitutionIdType

InstitutionNameType.description: Whether the name is given in full or abbreviated.
InstitutionNameType.title: InstitutionNameType

InstitutionType.description:
Contains information to identify the institution.

Either `id` (persistent identifiers) or `name` (human-readable) must be
given.

name.description: The names are meant to be human-readable. Either this element or the institution's `id` is required.
name.title: Name

id.description: Either this element or the institution's `name` is required.
id.title: Id

InstitutionType.title: InstitutionType

PartOfContractType.description:
Contains identifiers to link this publication to a contract (§7.1).

Providing just a `primary_identifier` is possible to denote that a
publication belongs to a contract but was still paid for individually.

group_id.description: Identical to the `group_id` of an `opencost:contract//opencost:cost_data//opencost:invoice_group` element. Indicates that publication costs relate to that particular `invoice_group` within a defined accounting period of a contract. Can be omitted to just link a publication to a certain contract. Generating a `uuid` or using another type of unique identifier is recommended.
group_id.title: Group Id

primary_identifier.description: Identical to the `primary_identifier` of an `opencost:contract` and indicates that the article was published under that contract.

PartOfContractType.title: PartOfContractType

ParticipationType.description:
Contains information on the dates an institution joined and left a
contract (§4).

to.description: The date when the institution left the contract. Not to be confused with the end date of the agreement itself, which may be later.
to.title: To

from.description: The date when the institution joined the contract. Not to be confused with the start date of the agreement itself, which may be earlier.
from.title: From

ParticipationType.title: ParticipationType

PublicationAmountPaidType.description:
A single amount paid by the institution (§7.2.5.1).

Usually corresponding to an item on the invoice.

amount.description: Amount of the `amount_paid`. Net monetary value. Negative or zero values are valid to denote reimbursements or Diamond OA models.
amount.title: Amount

cost_type.description: Describes the object/purpose of the payment. If the VAT cannot be subdivided specifically for the individual cost types, but only for the total amount of the invoice, a separate entry with the `cost_type` `vat` is possible here instead of the `vat` field (7.2.5.1.4).

vat.description: Vat of the `amount_paid`. State in the same currency as `amount`. Must be specified and assigned according to the individual cost type; if a differentiated specification is not possible, use a separate entry with `cost_type` `vat` (7.2.5.1.3).
vat.title: Vat

PublicationAmountPaidType.title: PublicationAmountPaidType

PublicationAmountsPaid.description: Contains all itemized amounts paid corresponding to one invoice (§7.2.5).
PublicationAmountsPaid.title: PublicationAmountsPaid

PublicationCostDataType.description:
Aggregates all publication-related payments (§7).

Payments are recorded as `invoice` elements; a transformative agreement
can be referenced via a `part_of_contract` element. At least one of the
two must be provided.

invoice.description: An `invoice` block encapsulates payment information and is meant to correspond to a real-world invoice.
invoice.title: Invoice

part_of_contract.description: Links this publication to a contract.

PublicationCostDataType.title: PublicationCostDataType

PublicationCostType.description:
Publication cost type (§7.2.5.1.3): the object/purpose of the payment.

Definitions from the openCost cost-types glossary:

- `gold-oa`: charges for the Open Access status in a pure Open Access
  publication organ; usually named APC, BPC etc. on the invoice.
- `hybrid-oa`: charges for the Open Access status in a Closed Access
  publication organ.
- `vat`: value added tax.
- `colour charge`: charges for colour printing (colour images, pages,
  illustrations, etc.); relevance for print versions.
- `cover charge`: charges for the illustration of a cover (publication of
  content for cover/cover design).
- `page charge`: charges for excess length or page-based billing (the
  latter may then not appear as an additional charge, but functionally
  replaces a Processing Charge, to be assigned to the gold- or hybrid-oa
  categories).
- `permission`: charges for the acquisition of a license (right of use,
  e.g. for an image in order to be able to use it within a publication).
- `publication charge`: publication charges to be paid in the context of
  Closed Access.
- `reprint`: reproduction charges for copies of publications.
- `submission fee`: charges for submitting a publication.
- `payment fee`: charges for the financial transaction of the payment
  (e.g. bank transfer or credit card charges).
- `other`: all other charges that are not already defined elsewhere in
  the glossary and cannot be assigned to any of the named categories.
PublicationCostType.title: PublicationCostType

PublicationInvoiceType.description:
Encapsulates payment information, meant to correspond to a real-world
invoice (§7.2).

amount_invoice.description: The total price as stated on the invoice.

invoice_number.description: Optional invoice number. As mentioned on the invoice.
invoice_number.title: Invoice Number

amounts_paid.description: All itemized amounts paid corresponding to this invoice.

creditor.description: Payment receiver as mentioned on the invoice. Might not be the actual publisher, but also e.g. a service provider from another publisher.
creditor.title: Creditor

PublicationInvoiceType.title: PublicationInvoiceType

PublicationPrimaryIdentifier.description:
Contains the primary identifier for the publication (§2).

A `doi` is strongly preferred, otherwise a `bibliographic_information`
block has to be provided instead.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier (doi) to identify the publication. Serves as primary identifier.

bibliographic_information.description: Backup description; only has to be given if no `doi` can be provided.

PublicationPrimaryIdentifier.title: PublicationPrimaryIdentifier

PublicationType.description:
Top-level element, corresponds to a single publication for which costs
are to be recorded (§1).

institution.description: Contains information to identify the paying institution.

publication_type.description: Type of the publication as the reporting institution categorizes it. COAR controlled vocabulary (v3.2) English label or the corresponding COAR PURL; PURLs are recommended as language-independent persistent identifiers.

external_costsplitting.description: Indicates if costs for this publication have been split with another institution. This element should only be added if there is distinct information (either positive or negative) on external cost splitting.
external_costsplitting.title: External Costsplitting

PublicationType.title: PublicationType
